title: Pricing · add-ons
description: ServiceWand pricing add-ons block for independently editable capacity and usage units such as building packs, routing tokens, seats, and implementation support.

source.adapted_from: Information architecture reference only: separate credit/add-on rows. Visual language normalized to ServiceWand lab-ui tokens.
source.decision: Stage 1 pricing scaffold — keep add-ons separate from plans so capacity and usage units can become CRM-managed later.

notes: Add-on slots are numbered and intentionally independent from plan slots.
Plan eligibility is displayed as text in stage 1; CRM rules can own actual eligibility later.
Routing optimization tokens are modeled as a usage add-on, not as a core plan feature.
